datasets.name: ds_runs
queryLines:
SELECT ingestion_id, channel_name, started_at, ended_at, status, COALESCE(error_message, '-') AS error_message, duration_seconds 
FROM vw_dashboard_ingestion_runs 
WHERE started_at >= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP() - INTERVAL 30 DAYS 
ORDER BY started_at DESC 
LIMIT 500

datasets.name: ds_video_trend
queryLines:
WITH dates AS (
  SELECT EXPLODE(SEQUENCE(CURRENT_DATE() - INTERVAL 89 DAYS, CURRENT_DATE(), INTERVAL 1 DAY)) AS collected_date
), active_videos AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT video_id FROM vw_dashboard_video_targets WHERE is_active
)
SELECT active.video_id, MAX_BY(metrics.video_title, metrics.collected_at) AS video_title, MAX_BY(metrics.channel_title, metrics.collected_at) AS channel_title, dates.collected_date, MAX_BY(metrics.view_count, metrics.collected_at) AS view_count, MAX_BY(metrics.like_count, metrics.collected_at) AS like_count, MAX_BY(metrics.comment_count, metrics.collected_at) AS comment_count 
FROM dates CROSS JOIN active_videos AS active 
LEFT JOIN vw_dashboard_video_metrics AS metrics ON metrics.video_id = active.video_id AND metrics.collected_at < dates.collected_date + INTERVAL 1 DAY 
GROUP BY active.video_id, dates.collected_date 
HAVING view_count IS NOT NULL 
ORDER BY collected_date

datasets.name: ds_channel_trend
queryLines:
WITH dates AS (
  SELECT EXPLODE(SEQUENCE(CURRENT_DATE() - INTERVAL 89 DAYS, CURRENT_DATE(), INTERVAL 1 DAY)) AS collected_date
), active_channels AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT metrics.channel_id FROM vw_dashboard_video_metrics AS metrics INNER JOIN vw_dashboard_video_targets AS targets ON metrics.video_id = targets.video_id WHERE targets.is_active
)
SELECT active.channel_id, MAX_BY(metrics.channel_title, metrics.collected_at) AS channel_title, dates.collected_date, MAX_BY(metrics.subscriber_count, metrics.collected_at) AS subscriber_count, MAX_BY(metrics.video_count, metrics.collected_at) AS video_count 
FROM dates CROSS JOIN active_channels AS active 
LEFT JOIN vw_dashboard_channel_metrics AS metrics ON metrics.channel_id = active.channel_id AND metrics.collected_at < dates.collected_date + INTERVAL 1 DAY 
GROUP BY active.channel_id, dates.collected_date 
HAVING subscriber_count IS NOT NULL 
ORDER BY collected_date

datasets.name: ds_latest_videos
queryLines:
WITH ranked_snapshots AS (
  SELECT metrics.video_id AS video_id, metrics.video_title AS video_title, metrics.channel_title AS channel_title, metrics.collected_at AS collected_at, metrics.view_count AS view_count, metrics.like_count AS like_count, metrics.comment_count AS comment_count,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY metrics.video_id ORDER BY metrics.collected_at DESC) AS row_num
  FROM vw_dashboard_video_metrics AS metrics
  INNER JOIN vw_dashboard_video_targets AS targets ON metrics.video_id = targets.video_id
  WHERE targets.is_active
)
SELECT video_id, video_title, channel_title, collected_at, view_count, like_count, comment_count 
FROM ranked_snapshots 
WHERE row_num = 1 
ORDER BY view_count DESC

datasets.name: ds_comment_coverage_video
queryLines:
WITH reply_counts AS (
  SELECT parent_id, COUNT(DISTINCT comment_id) AS replies_collected
  FROM replies
  WHERE parent_id IS NOT NULL AND parent_id <> ''
  GROUP BY parent_id
), video_details AS (
  SELECT video_id, MAX_BY(title, ingested_at) AS video_title, MAX_BY(channel_id, ingested_at) AS channel_id
  FROM videos
  GROUP BY video_id
), channel_details AS (
  SELECT channel_id, MAX_BY(title, ingested_at) AS channel_title
  FROM channels
  GROUP BY channel_id
)
SELECT comments.video_id, COALESCE(videos.video_title, comments.video_id) AS video_title, channels.channel_title, COUNT(DISTINCT comments.thread_id) AS threads_collected, COUNT(DISTINCT comments.comment_id) AS top_level_comments_collected, COALESCE(SUM(comments.reply_count), 0) AS replies_declared, COALESCE(SUM(reply_counts.replies_collected), 0) AS replies_collected, CAST(COALESCE(SUM(reply_counts.replies_collected), 0) AS DOUBLE) / NULLIF(COALESCE(SUM(comments.reply_count), 0), 0) AS reply_coverage
FROM comments
LEFT JOIN reply_counts ON comments.comment_id = reply_counts.parent_id
LEFT JOIN video_details AS videos ON comments.video_id = videos.video_id
LEFT JOIN channel_details AS channels ON videos.channel_id = channels.channel_id
GROUP BY comments.video_id, videos.video_title, channels.channel_title
ORDER BY reply_coverage ASC NULLS LAST, replies_collected DESC

datasets.name: ds_comment_coverage_thread
queryLines:
WITH reply_counts AS (
  SELECT parent_id, COUNT(DISTINCT comment_id) AS replies_collected
  FROM replies
  WHERE parent_id IS NOT NULL AND parent_id <> ''
  GROUP BY parent_id
), video_details AS (
  SELECT video_id, MAX_BY(title, ingested_at) AS video_title
  FROM videos
  GROUP BY video_id
)
SELECT comments.video_id, COALESCE(videos.video_title, comments.video_id) AS video_title, comments.thread_id, comments.comment_id, comments.reply_count AS replies_declared, COALESCE(reply_counts.replies_collected, 0) AS replies_collected, CAST(COALESCE(reply_counts.replies_collected, 0) AS DOUBLE) / NULLIF(comments.reply_count, 0) AS reply_coverage
FROM comments
LEFT JOIN reply_counts ON comments.comment_id = reply_counts.parent_id
LEFT JOIN video_details AS videos ON comments.video_id = videos.video_id
WHERE comments.reply_count > 0
ORDER BY reply_coverage ASC NULLS LAST, replies_declared DESC
